messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Meridian Health renewal scheduled in 2 weeks. They verbally accepted the revised pricing but procurement flagged a billing-entity mismatch and vendor code. They say they need an updated SOW + vendor form signed before PO routes. cc @aj_sales

aj_sales: On a call with their procurement earlier. They want the SOW to explicitly list net30 terms and include the PO# on invoices. Also asked if we can accept credit card payment while their PO is processed (they have an internal freeze).

ben_finance: We can accept CC for the first invoice as a temporary fallback if sales confirms T&Cs. Need invoice header to read: "Redwood Inference SaaS, EIN 12-3456789" and we must capture CC authorization form.

maria_cs: Procurement attached a vendor form. Quick note — their vendor code is 9988 but our contract shows vendor code 9899. Who owns vendor mapping? @lena_legal please advise. Also they asked to add 3 dedicated onboarding days to the SOW.

lena_legal: I can take the vendor-code mismatch. If it’s just a numeric mapping issue we can attach a one-page addendum correcting vendor code and clarifying billing entity. Need the vendor form PDF id or a screenshot of the field. Also we’ll need the AP signer name and email for e-sign.

maria_cs: Uploading the key PO details they gave during the call:
```
PO#: MH-2026-0421
Amount: $48,000
Billing entity: Meridian Health - Meridian Holdings, Inc.
Vendor code: 9988
Requested changes: add 3 onboarding days, net30, include PO# on invoice
```

aj_sales: :thinking_face: They also asked for a 3-month pilot discount clause (they want a short performance window). That’s a commercial concession — needs pricing approval.

frank_ae: I can sign off on the commercial term sheet but we should not change the renewal term without CAO approval. @ben_finance are you OK with CC fallback while we process the PO?

ben_finance: Confirmed — CC fallback OK. Payment team will need to send a secure credit form link. I’ll generate the link after sales confirms the final invoice amount.

maria_cs: Onboarding impact: enablement needs the training week scheduled for May 3 to hit the activation milestone. If signatures slip more than 7 days we risk delaying go-live and raising churn probability. @ops_bot can you create a tentative calendar hold for the enablement window?

ops_bot: Calendar hold created — "Meridian Onboarding (tentative) May 3-7". Invites sent to: maria_cs, aj_sales, customer-success@redwood.com, enablement_team@redwood.com

lena_legal: I’ll draft the vendor-code addendum and an e-sign packet (one-page addendum + updated SOW with 3 onboarding days) and route it today. Expect a DocuSign link by EOD.

aj_sales: I’ll confirm with their procurement lead that CC is acceptable temporarily and ask for the AP contact name/email for e-sign. I’ll also push back on the pilot discount and ask them to document the acceptance criteria.

maria_cs: Thanks — tl;dr next steps: 1) lena to send vendor-code addendum + SOW update for e-sign, 2) aj to confirm CC fallback and get AP signer contact, 3) ben to provide secure CC authorization link once amount finalized, 4) I’ll track risk in the renewal playbook and keep enablement calendar hold. Risk level: moderate (signature timing + billing-entity).
